question: Mitsubishi Electric Corporation parent company owner
markdown:
Mitsubishi Electric Corporation is an independent, publicly traded company on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TOKYO: 6503) with no single parent company. It is a core member of the Mitsubishi keiretsu but not owned by Mitsubishi Corporation. Founded in 1921 as a spin-off from Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, it had 146,518 employees and 203 global locations in 2021. It recently acquired AG MELCO Elevator Co. in 2025.
Mitsubishi Electric Corporation is an independent, publicly traded company with no single parent company or owner.
Shares of Mitsubishi Electric are traded on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TOKYO: 6503).
Major global and Japanese institutional investors and trust banks (such as the Master Trust Bank of Japan and various global asset managers) hold large portions of its stock.
It is a core member of the wider Mitsubishi keiretsu (a loose alliance of independent companies sharing the Mitsubishi brand and history), but it is not owned by Mitsubishi Corporation or any other single entity.
It originally spun off from Mitsubishi Shipbuilding (now Mitsubishi Heavy Industries) in 1921, but operates completely independently today.
Mitsubishi Electric was established as a spin-off from the Mitsubishi Group's other core company Mitsubishi Heavy Industries.
Mitsubishi Electric India Pvt. Ltd. was incorporated in 2010 with CIN U51909DL2010FTC227827.
Mitsubishi Electric (TOKYO: 6503) acquired 100% of AG MELCO Elevator Co. L.L.C. from Rawafed Almustaqbal Group L.L.C. (Al Ghurair) on 21 Nov 2025.
Mitsubishi Electric was founded in 1921; its first product was an electric fan.
In 2021, Mitsubishi Electric had 146,518 employees, 203 global locations, and 35.4B EUR annual sales.
Yataro Iwasaki founded Mitsubishi in 1870 as a shipping firm.
The Mitsubishi emblem is a 3-diamond mark representing the family crest and Tosa crest.
Major shareholders of Mitsubishi Electric Corporation include Meiji Yasuda Life Insurance Co., BlackRock Japan Co. Ltd., and Bowen Hanes & Co.
